reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed record identifiers, performs exact need-to-capability matching, marks matched capabilities as direct coverage, and leaves unmatched needs with empty capability_id and unsupported coverage. This matches the declared boundary role and the supplied input/output evidence.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported true when coverage == 'direct'. As a result, covered direct needs are ranked before truly unsupported needs, contradicting the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream provenance rank. The final priorities show this inversion: direct records n06-r02 through n06-r08 are marked unsupported true, while genuinely unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 are marked unsupported false and pushed to priorities 7 and 8.

synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item priority window and constructs the recommendation directly from the first already-ranked priority record. The incorrect top_need is downstream of the inverted unsupported ordering in prioritize_needs, not a local synthesis defect.
